SELECT title, description, link, enabled FROM advertisement WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO advertisement (id, title, description, link, enabled) VALUES (1, #{title}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{link}, #{enabled}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, link = EXCLUDED.link, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled
